def check_constraints():
    # Object is NULL (ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR true), so kfree returns early.
    # folio_test_slab is not evaluated since early return occurs.
    # No additional constraints needed beyond existing ones.
    #
    # Represent the NULL pointer condition as an Int variable equal to 0.
    ptr = 0  # object is NULL

    # ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR(ptr) is true when ptr == 0
    zero_or_null_ptr = 1 if ptr == 0 else 0

    # kfree returns early when ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR is true
    kfree_early_return = 1 if zero_or_null_ptr == 1 else 0

    # folio_test_slab is NOT evaluated because of the early return
    folio_test_slab_evaluated = 0 if kfree_early_return == 1 else 1

    # Validation: early return must have occurred, and folio_test_slab must not be evaluated
    return bool(kfree_early_return == 1 and folio_test_slab_evaluated == 0)
